title: Semantically compressed release snippets and translation mapper
author: Asha Menon
release_notes: Add compact, semantically-compressed release snippets with optional locale-aware translation mapping. Improves readability of autogenerated changelogs and provides a lightweight API to request human-friendly one-line release blurbs per locale or product audience. No breaking changes to onboarding contract. Includes docs and tests.
description:
Context and motivation: We often generate long machine-centric changelogs from model onboarding metadata; product writers and external customers prefer concise, actionable blurbs. This PR adds a semantically-compressed snippet generator that summarizes model onboarding deltas (profile changes, major performance deltas, compatibility notes) into 1-2 sentence release snippets and an independent translation mapper that sanitizes and maps those snippets into locale-friendly variants.

What this changes (high level):
- Introduce a semantic compression pipeline that uses a lightweight tokenizer+scoring heuristic to compress multi-line release content into a ranked set of candidate blurbs (file: onboard/summarizer/semantic_snippet_compressor.py).
- Add a translation mapper service to convert canonical snippets into locale-aware variants and apply simple idiomatic rewrites (file: onboard/translation/mapper.py).
- CLI preview tool to generate snippet bundles for release drafts (scripts/generate_release_preview.py).
- Documentation page with usage examples and prompts for manual curation (docs/release-guides/compact-snippet.md).
- Unit and integration tests (tests/test_snippet_compression.py, tests/test_translation_mapper.py).
- CI workflow to produce a preview artifact for the Release team (ci/workflows/release-preview.yml).

Checklist: [x] Unit tests added and passing locally; [x] Integration preview validated with sample registry payloads; [x] Docs updated with example prompts and per-locale caveats; [x] Perf smoke tested against 1k onboarding items.

Commits (summary):
- e1c2d9b: initial semantic compressor implementation and evaluation harness
- 3a7f1bc: add translation mapper with locale rules and normalization table
- a9f05d4: CLI preview generator and small UX for reviewers
- b4d8e28: docs and unit tests; fix edge-cases in UTF-8 trimming and emoji removal

Files changed (high level):
- onboard/summarizer/semantic_snippet_compressor.py (new): core summarization pipeline and heuristics.
- onboard/translation/mapper.py (new): canonical->locale mapping + small rule engine.
- scripts/generate_release_preview.py (new): convenience CLI used by release managers.
- docs/release-guides/compact-snippet.md (new): guide and examples.
- tests/test_snippet_compression.py (new), tests/test_translation_mapper.py (new).
- ci/workflows/release-preview.yml (updated): adds preview artifact job.

Small illustrative snippet (compressor API):
- input: full-onboard-delta.json (profile + telemetry + compatibility notes)
- compressor.compress(delta) -> ["Reduced memory usage by ~20% at 512-token workloads; recommend v1.3 for cost-sensitive inference.", "Deprecated GPU-quantized variant for x86; fallback to float model is recommended."]
- mapper.localize(snippets, locale=\"es-ES\") -> ["Uso de memoria reducido ~20% en cargas de 512 tokens; recomendamos v1.3 para entornos sensibles al coste."]

Review conversation: 
- Liam O'Connor (reviewer): "Nice work, Asha. Two concerns: 1) the heuristics rely on token counts — can we ensure stability for very short/very long profiles? 2) Add a rate-limit on the translation mapper (it will be called by the Release preview job)."
- Asha (author reply): "Addressed. Compressor now normalizes by semantic span (not raw tokens); added a configurable length cap and a per-job rate limiter. See second commit 3a7f1bc for implementation. Added tests to cover short/long extremes."
- Priya Shah (reviewer): "Add a short blurb in the docs that explains locale fallbacks and how to opt-out of auto-localization. Also, add a smoke test that runs the preview job in CI so Release can sanity-check outputs."
- Asha: "Docs updated and added ci/release-preview artifact job; smoke test added as tests/integration/preview_smoke.py referenced by the workflow."
- Tomás Rivera (reviewer): "Performance: the compressor has a worst-case O(n^2) step for pairwise sentence scoring. Looks acceptable for our 1k sample but we should note the algorithmic complexity in the code and open a follow-up ticket to add a linearized approximation."
- Asha: "Noted in code comments and linked ENG-1412 to track the linearized version. Follow-up task added to Linear."

CI summary: Initial run: lint + unit tests + integration preview. One flaky test in translation mapper failed (race in the locale cache) causing CI to fail on first run. I pushed a fix controlling cache initialization and retriggered CI; final run: all checks pass (lint, unit, integration, release-preview artifact generation).

Testing notes: Unit coverage added for compressor heuristics (edge cases: empty profile, multi-variant diffs, long text). Integration test validates the preview artifact includes one canonical snippet per model variant and a mapped locale bundle for en-US and es-ES. Perf smoke: compressor completes under 110ms median for a 1k-item synthetic sample on the CI runner class.

Rollout plan:
- Merge to main behind feature flag (registry:release.compact_snippets=false by default).
- Release team runs preview artifacts for the next two weekly releases to validate quality.
- After 2 successful previews and editorial signoff, flip the flag and enable auto-suggest for internal release notes.

Backward compatibility: No changes to model onboarding contract; the compressor consumes existing delta payloads. Translation mapper is additive and behind config; no customer-facing API changes.

Follow-ups and future work:
- ENG-1412: linearized compressor approximation for very large onboard batches.
- PM-387: UX flow to approve and edit suggested snippets from the Release console.
- Intl backlog: add locale coverage for zh-CN and fr-FR and integrate with translation memory for non-machine-translated defaults.

Merge: After approvals from reviewers and green CI, I squashed and merged this PR to main on 2025-11-12 (merge method: squash).
